open_points.subject: StaffAccount email-verified mark lifecycle
open_points.text: A staff account keeps a recorded "email verified" mark: the administrator's activation, the first administrator's creation (R0-07) and the recovery override (R0-20) set it
open_points.question: What value does the email-verified mark have when an administrator creates a pending staff account, before activation?

witness.initial: An active administrator exists and no account exists for new.operator@example.com.
events: The administrator creates a staff account for new.operator@example.com; it enters pending_verification.
The administrator reads the new account before activating it.
outcomes: The account view reports email_verified=true or an unset value.
witness.observer: The administrator reading the pending account

open_points.subject: StaffAccount email-verified mark visibility
open_points.text: and the account view shows it
open_points.question: Which concrete account-reading operation shows the email-verified mark, and which principals may perform that operation?
options: every staff-account list and detail representation

witness.initial: An active operator account has its email-verified mark set, and an active administrator manages that account.
events: The operator logs in and requests the available representation of their own account.
The administrator requests the available representation of the operator's account.
outcomes: Only the administrator-facing staff-account view exposes the mark.
The holder-facing account view also exposes the mark, or is the sole view meant by the text.
witness.observer: The operator and administrator using their respective account views
